status: PROPOSED (not approved, not wired into the app). Jacket picking + layering + fall/winter coverage + rotation. Built on prod b03aa4d sim rows and the 2026-09-30 closet_meta snapshot.

conventions.slots: top, mid, outer, bottom, shoe. outer = class a/b/c only (jacket_class). Outerwear named cardigan/fleece/vest/gilet/zip sweater/zip-up knit = MID and never counts as a jacket. RECLASS (JKT-DATA-1) is applied before slotting (Khaki varsity = outer).
conventions.jacket_class: a_tailored (signal tailored), c_outer_coat (signal outer_coat), mid (signal mid_layer), else b_casual
conventions.cut: tailored | roomy (roomy_casual_jacket) | waist (waist_casual_jacket) | close_light (close_light_jacket or warmth <= 2)
conventions.weight: heavy = warmth >= 4 or shearling/sherpa/parka/overcoat; light = warmth <= 2 or trucker/overshirt/zip blouson/linen or mint; tailored wool = mid; else mid
conventions.severity: hard = look is illegal; soft = add delta to rank score (same semantics as house profiles)
conventions.match_blob: keyword specs match name | subtype | material, word-start, case-insensitive (build.py match()). Extension keys used here: warmth_min, warmth_max, fit_none (closet_meta warmth/fit are already in the snapshot).

tailored_soft.note: Unstructured/soft sport coat (approved blazer_soft minus the DB). Joe: Taupe blazer, Beige corduroy blazer.

tailored_structured.note: Joe: Navy blazer, Ivory double-breasted blazer.

roomy_casual_jacket.note: Hip-length / boxy cut with room in the body: goes over a bulky or relaxed knit.

waist_casual_jacket.note: Waist-length, rib or band hem (trucker, bomber, varsity, cord/suede jacket of unknown cut, sherpa trucker): over a chunky knit only when the knit is regular fit.

close_light_jacket.note: Light, close-cut shell or shirt-jacket: never over a chunky knit.

mid_layer.note: Knit/fleece/vest layers. Filed as outerwear they are still MID (slot_of), never count as a jacket.

outerwear_weight_mid.note: Cream cable-knit cardigan, Cream printed fleece pullover, Grey herringbone puffer vest.

chunky_knit.note: Chunky = a chunky keyword, OR a knit rated warmth >= 4, OR a relaxed/oversized-fit sweater (bulk at the armhole/chest). Joe's live chunky tops: Grey knit sweater (Acne, relaxed, 4), Black/Brown/Cream cable-knit sweaters, Beige cable-knit half-zip, Cream fair isle half-zip, Beige ribbed (4), Beige textured (4), Blue ivory diamond knit (relaxed), Cream ribbed half-zip (relaxed), Cream cable-knit cardigan (mid).

fine_knit.note: Fine/mid-gauge whitelist: fine-gauge keywords, knit polos/collared sweaters/knit shirts, or a plain crew/knit sweater that is regular fit and warmth <= 3 (Beige crewneck, Beige knit, Beige gradient, Navy R sweater, Burgundy collared sweater, Brown knit polo, Pale yellow ribbed polo, Green herringbone knit shirt).

athletic_layer.note: Never under a sport coat: hoodie, sweatshirt (incl. quarter-zip sweatshirts), fleece, track top, puffer/vest/gilet.

cross_chip_coverage_rules.name: jacket_required_fall_winter
cross_chip_coverage_rules.description: A jacket or coat (class a/b/c; MID knits do not count) is REQUIRED on Weekday and Out in Fall and Winter (hard; supersedes XC-TEX-8 soft branch and generalises POLO-P7/PL-P1/IW-P1). WEEKEND (decision): Winter hard; Fall soft -15 when missing, reduced to -5 when the top/mid is a heavy chunky knit (warmth >= 4), waived (0) when the look has an outerwear-weight MID (cable cardigan, fleece pullover, puffer vest). Travel: Winter hard, Fall -10. Comfy: optional. Spring/Summer: optional. Weather override (optional, if the app passes live temp): >= 72F turns the Weekday/Out hard into -10.
